entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Gather your study materials and[n]come to the diner in Shibuya.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What else besides studying?[n]Now quit complaining and[n]get over here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm glad you're so obedient.[n]I'll be waiting.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you need me to come to[n]your house and pick you up?[n]You can't get away from this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought we could have a[n]study session with everyone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll drill it into you[n]real good, so be ready.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to say anything... I could[n]hear Makoto's voice from over here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like you don't have a choice.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Thanks to Ryuji, our day off is turning[n]into a disaster...
